mentions.name: Ktext
mentions.description: This tool gives Claude Code sessions compact, high-quality codebase context so they don't waste tokens exploring the codebase. It consists of two parts: a CONTEXT.yaml file that adheres to a JSON Schema, and the ktext CLI that helps create, validate, and export it.
mentions.problem: Every new Claude Code session needs codebase context, and otherwise spends a bunch of tokens looking around and discovering it.
